是个狠人（是个狠人（第22页）山洞之外的天从白日渐渐转为黑夜，又从黑夜传为白天，直至第三天天边彩霞遍布时，李婉身上的疼痛才渐歇。此时的李婉如刚从水中捞出来的一般，衣裳被血和汗浸湿，头发狼狈的贴在脸上，脸色惨白如纸。她下嘴唇被咬出一个巨大的口子，鲜血顺着脖颈流入衣裳，蜿蜒出一条血线。李婉强撑着眼，忍住疲惫，看见骨锥从自己的心口飞出，漂浮在半空。此刻的骨锥早已经不是先前暗淡泛花的摸样，它浑身散发着刺眼的灵光，通体莹白中夹杂着血红色的符文，神秘又古老。李婉伸出手，骨锥便乖乖的落入了她的手上。身边的玉膏丹落在地面沾染了灰尘，李婉也不嫌弃，她从地上将丹药捡起，拂去上面的灰尘，这才将它放进口中。丹药一入口，便立马化做一股精纯的灵力，将丹田处的伤口治愈。依旧感应不到灵气，但是李婉心中却知道，自己的身体发生了某种质的变化，而这种变化或许就是她一直以来梦寐以求的。来不及进一步验证，李婉就再也撑不住，歪在山洞中，沉沉睡去。李婉醒来时，山洞之外月朗星疏，正是月半时分。远处墨色的山岚中不时传来几声怪异的哀嚎，在寂静的山岭之中听起来颇为渗人。放置在洞口隐秘的麻线并没有改变位置，这说明山洞里没有人来过。李婉从地上坐起来，五指抓握。和之前好像没什么两样。有没有成功凿出灵根还是得去找个专业的测灵石测一下。但是这玩意，好像在大宗门大世家内部也是极其珍贵的东西，她想要测灵根，只能另找宗门拜入。流林宗是不能回去了。她入宗时不过一个凡人，这事招她进宗的管事和一起共事的杂役们都知道。若是她这次真的凿灵根成功，那么只要一开始修炼，她在流林宗的处境将会变得特别危险。甚至要比几百年前的王阳明更甚，毕竟王阳明身后可是站着家族和实力强劲的族老的。而她身后，却空无一人。横竖来看，都是一个很好捏的软柿子。怀璧其罪。那群知道神器凿灵的人肯定不会放过她，所以流林宗不仅不能回，还得离得远远的才行。好在她只是一个小杂役，整个宗门，恐怕也只有自己的债主花管事会关心几句她的去处，其余人根本不会在乎她的死活。李婉这次出门的时候去饭堂买了三个馒头和一壶水，她整整两天没吃饭，饿得整个胃都开始痉挛，头晕眼花，手也控制不住的颤抖。这是低血糖的症状。吃了两颗奶糖后，她低血糖的症状缓解了些，李婉开始就着冷水吃馒头。在天边泛起青色之时，李婉抹掉她来过的痕迹，离开了山洞。她从无忧城过来的时候，曾路过一个小城镇，她打算去哪里进行一些补给和打听消息。小镇并不大，但因处于去往无忧城的要道，镇子上南来的北往的，来这里补给的人很多，这些人里，既有修士，也有普通凡人和商队。这正好方便了李婉打听消息。

He is a ruthless man (He is a ruthless man (p. 22)) The sky outside the cave gradually turned from day to night, and then from night to day. It was not until the third day when the sky was filled with colorful clouds that the pain in Li Wan's body gradually subsided. At this time, Li Wan looked like she had just been fished out of the water. Her clothes were soaked with blood and sweat, her hair was stuck to her face in a mess, and her face was as pale as paper. There was a huge gash on her lower lip, and blood flowed into her clothes along her neck. A line of blood snaked out. Li Wan held her eyes tightly, holding back the fatigue, and saw the bone awl flying out of her heart. The bone awl at this moment was no longer dim and flowery. It was exuding a dazzling spiritual light, and was mixed with blood-red runes. Li Wan stretched out her hand, and the bone awl fell into her hand obediently. The jade cream pill beside her fell on the ground and was stained with dust. , she picked up the elixir from the ground, brushed off the dust, and then put it into her mouth. As soon as the elixir was taken into her mouth, it immediately turned into a pure spiritual force, healing the wound in her Dantian. She still couldn't sense the aura, but Li Wan knew in her heart that her body had undergone some kind of qualitative change, and this change might be what she had always dreamed of. Before she could further verify it, Li Wan couldn't hold on any longer and lay in the cave. , fell into a deep sleep. When Li Wan woke up, the moon was bright and starry, and it was half moon. From time to time, there were strange wailing sounds in the dark mountains, which sounded quite permeable in the silent mountains. This showed that no one had been in the cave. Li Wan sat up from the ground and held it with five fingers. It seemed that he still had to find a spiritual root. A professional spiritual stone test. But this thing seems to be extremely precious within the big sect. If she wants to find a spiritual root, she can only find another sect to join. She can't go back to the Liulin Sect. The stewards who recruited her and the servants who work with her know this. If she really succeeds in digging the spiritual root this time, her situation in the Liulin Sect will become special. Dangerous. Even more so than Wang Yangming hundreds of years ago. After all, Wang Yangming is standing behind a powerful clan leader. But there is no one behind her. She seems to be a soft persimmon. Those who know the magic weapon will definitely not let her go, so Liulin Sect not only cannot return, but also has to stay away. Fortunately, she is only a small servant. Her creditor, Manager Hua, would care about her whereabouts, but no one else would care about her life or death. When Li Wan went out this time, she went to the canteen and bought three steamed buns and a bottle of water. She didn't eat for two days, and her whole stomach started to cramp, she was dizzy, and her hands were shaking uncontrollably. This was a symptom of hypoglycemia. After eating two toffee, her hypoglycemia symptoms improved, and Li Wan started eating steamed buns with cold water. When the color turned green, Li Wan wiped away the traces of her presence and left the cave. When she came from Wuyou City, she passed by a small town where she planned to make some supplies and inquire about information. The town was not big, but because it was on the main road to Wuyou City, there were many people coming here from the south and north to provide supplies. Among them, there were monks, ordinary mortals, and caravans. This was convenient for Li Wan to inquire about information.
